items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: He came to the Charlie Hospital one day, and I think you just had him there when I was in the Charlie Hospital.

ctx.x: Well, Eddie Cason was outstanding. And so another person called Joe Howard. He was really outstanding man. Because he used to play trumpet. And then that guy, he would go on the bass. But what he had in the other person, too, you call Pierre Anderson. And then he said, I tried it on the bass. And the first time I tried it on his trumpet. And then the bass, when he got the bass, the instrument played bass. And if he did bass, he ran off with it. You see, any man that a trumpet, if he ever could play the trumpet…
Oh, while we're at it, what about this fella, Munster for Johnson, you were telling me about?

Yes, he's such a young man. He came to the Charlie Hospital one day, and I think you just had him there when I was in the Charlie Hospital. Yeah, because on this bed number two, his cousin was in this bed number two.
